source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of stellar evolution (PDF 12-15).

blocks.text: Kinetic theory jab sitaron aur kehkashaon jaise falkiyati nizamon tak phailayi jaye to sitaron ka irtiqa samajhne mein madad deti hai. Stellar evolution woh tareeqa hai jis se sitara waqt ke saath badalta hai. Sitaron ki umrein chand million se trillion saal tak hoti hain, aur sitare ki zindagi us ki kamiyat (mass) par munhasir hai. Sab se kam kamiyat wale sitaron ki umar sab se lambi hai, kainat ki maujooda umar se bhi zyada.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke 'sab se bhari sitaron ki umar lambi hoti hai'. Haqeeqat ulat hai: bhari sitare apna eendhan bohat tezi se jalate aur sirf chand million saal jeete hain, jab ke sab se halke sitare (red dwarfs) trillion saal, kainat ki maujooda umar se bhi zyada, jeete hain. Kitab khud aage chal kar red dwarfs ke bare mein yahi kehti hai.

Tamam sitare gas aur gard ke badalon se bante hain jinhein nebulae ya molecular clouds kehte hain. Jab aisa badal kashish-e-saql se sukarta hai to us ki density aur darja hararat barhte hain, kyunke zarrat ki kinetic energy barhti hai (K.E., T ke mutanasib hai); sukarta badal proto-star hai. Millions saal baad proto-star tawazun ki halat wala sitara ban sakta hai. Figure 13.4 kashish-e-saql aur dabao ka muqabla dikhati hai: darja hararat barhne se andaruni dabao bhi barhta hai, aur mustahkam sitara tab banta hai jab andar ki taraf kashish-e-saql ki quwwat bahar ki taraf dabao se bilkul barabar ho. Ise hydrostatic equation dP/dr = -G Mr rho_r / r^2 bayan karti hai, jahan P sitare ke andar dabao, dP/dr markaz se faasle r ke saath dabao ki tabdeeli ki sharah, G = 6.67 x 10^-11 N m^2 kg^-2, Mr radius r ke andar kamiyat aur rho_r radius r par density hai. Manfi nishan batata hai ke dabao bahar ki taraf ghatta jab ke kashish-e-saql andar kheenchti hai.

blocks.alt: Teen gole. Baen: gole ke andar gulabi teer (self-gravity) andar ki taraf aur bahar neele teer (gas pressure) bahar ki taraf. Beech aur daen: gas ka badal jis ke chaaron taraf aik gulabi gravity teer andar aur aik neela pressure teer bahar hai; daen badal ke zarrat beech wale se kahin zyada qareeb qareeb hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.4: Kashish-e-saql (gravity) ka dabao bahar ki taraf pressure se barabar hota hai. Zyada gravity gas ko daba kar ghana aur garam karti hai (kitab ki Figure 13.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Agar tawazun qaim na rahe to do suratein hain: agar kashish-e-saql andaruni dabao se zyada ho to sitara sukar kar garam hota hai; agar andaruni dabao zyada ho to sitara phailta hai. Markaz ka darja hararat barhne par nuclear fusion shuru hota hai: hydrogen ke nuclei mil kar helium banate aur bohat zyada tawanai chhorte hain, jo sitare ko us ki zyada tar zindagi chalati aur kashish-e-saql ke inhidam ke khilaf thame rakhti hai.

Darja hararat mein mazeed izafe aur markaz ki tabdeeliyon se sitara phail kar red giant ban sakta hai. Sooraj ki taqreeban aadhi kamiyat ya zyada wale sitare phir helium ko carbon aur oxygen jaise bhari anasir mein fuse kar sakte hain, aur zyada bhari sitaron mein fusion marhala-war iron tak jari rehta hai. Sitare ka aakhri anjam zyada tar us ki kamiyat par munhasir hai. Jab sitara apna eendhan khatam kar leta hai to kashish-e-saql ke khilaf khud ko thame nahi rakh sakta. Kam aur darmiyani kamiyat ke sitaron mein markaz sukar kar ghana white dwarf banta aur bairooni tahein planetary nebula ki shakal mein bahar phenki jati hain. Sooraj se taqreeban das guna ya zyada kamiyat wale sitare supernova dhamake par khatam hote hain, jis mein iron ka markaz gir kar neutron star ya black hole banta hai. Red dwarfs, kam kamiyat aur eendhan ke dheeme istemal ki wajah se, itni ahista badalte hain ke kainat abhi itni purani nahi ke koi red dwarf apni zindagi mukammal kar chuka ho; models ke mutabiq yeh ahista ahista garam aur roshan ho kar kam kamiyat wale white dwarfs ban jayenge.

blocks.alt: Shaakhon wala chart. Stellar nebula se ya to average star banta, phir red giant, planetary nebula aur white dwarf; ya massive star, phir red super giant aur supernova, jo aakhir mein neutron star ya black hole ban jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.5: Sitare ka zindagi ka chakkar (kitab ki Figure 13.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure mein massive star wale raaste par red super giant ke baad wale marhale ka naam 'Positron' chhapa hai. Yeh ghalti hai: yeh marhala supernova hai, aik bohat bara dhamaka (explosion), aur khaake mein yahi likha hai. Oopar wala raasta Sooraj jaise ausat sitaron ka hai, neeche wala bhari sitaron ka; bhari sitare ka aakhri anjam neutron star ya black hole hota hai.

Neutron stars sab se ghane maloom ajsam mein se hain, sirf black holes se doosre number par. Intehai zyada density ki wajah se andar ka maddah degenerate gas ki tarah bartao karta hai, aur un ki taqatwar kashish-e-saql unhein model karna mushkil banati hai. NASA ke andazon ke mutabiq Milky Way mein aik arab tak neutron stars ho sakte hain. Dekhe gaye bohat se jawan aur tezi se ghoomte hain aur shuaon ki shu'aein (beams) bhejte hain; yeh pulsars hain. Khayal hai ke pulsar ki shuaein tab paida hoti hain jab taqatwar magnetic fields maddah ko magnetic poles ki taraf le jati hain. Jab sitara gir kar neutron star banta hai to us ka magnetic field bohat taqatwar ho jata hai, kyunke field lines qareeb qareeb dab jati hain.

blocks.alt: Neutron star jis ka aik hissa kaat kar andar dikhaya gaya hai. Markaz se bahar ki taraf safed teer par neutron degeneracy pressure likha hai, bahar se andar aata teer gravitational force hai, aur aik pointer bahar ki patli teh (thin atmosphere) dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.6: Neutron star ka qata (section) (kitab ki Figure 13.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Neutron star itna ghana hai ke is ke maddah ke aik chamche ki kamiyat 5.5 x 10^12 kg se zyada, Giza ke Bare Ahram ki kamiyat ka taqreeban 900 guna, hogi. Neutron star ki density par zameen ki poori kamiyat 305 m qutr ke gole mein sama jayegi.

Sooraj zameen ka sab se qareebi sitara aur hamare sayyare ke liye garmi aur roshni ka bara zariya hai. Yeh taqreeban 4.6 arab saal pehle gas aur gard ke aik bohat bare badal, solar nebula, se bana. Kashish-e-saql ke sukarne se markaz ka darja hararat barha aur protostar bana; jab markaz bohat garam ho gaya to hydrogen ka helium mein nuclear fusion shuru hua aur bohat tawanai nikli. Sooraj ki zindagi ke marahil nebula, protostar, main sequence, red giant, planetary nebula aur white dwarf hain. Is waqt Sooraj main-sequence marhale mein hai, hydrogen ko helium mein badal kar garmi aur roshni paida kar raha hai; yeh tawanai zyada tar radiation se muntaqil karta hai.

blocks.alt: Timeline: Birth aur phir 1 se 14, arab saal (taqreeban) mein. Sooraj paidaish ke baad ahista ahista garam (gradual warming) hota aur barhta hai; 4 aur 5 ke darmiyan Now ka teer hai. Taqreeban 10 par red giant, 11 par planetary nebula aur 12 se 14 tak white dwarf. Size paimane par nahi.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.5: Sooraj ka zindagi ka chakkar (kitab ki Figure 13.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; kitab yeh number do dafa chhapti hai).

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Parsec faasle ki ikai hai jo falkiyat-dan light-year ke mutabadil ke taur par use karte hain, jaise kilometre miles ke mutabadil hain. Aik parsec taqreeban 3.26 light-years, ya taqreeban 19 trillion miles (31 trillion km) hai.
Hal shuda misalein: kya sitara mustahkam hai?

Kitab kashish-e-saql ke dabao ke mote andaze, Pg taqreeban G M^2 / R^4, ka sitare ke andaruni dabao se muqabla karti hai. Misal 13.3: sitare ki kamiyat 2 x 10^30 kg aur radius 7 x 10^8 m hai; us ka gravitational dabao nikal kar andaruni dabao 1.0 x 10^14 Pa se muqabla karein. Pg = (6.67 x 10^-11)(2 x 10^30)^2 / (7 x 10^8)^4 = 2.668 x 10^50 / 2.401 x 10^35, taqreeban 1.1 x 10^15 Pa. Kashish-e-saql andaruni dabao se taqreeban gyarah guna hai, is liye sitara tawazun (equilibrium) mein nahi: yeh sukrega. Misal 13.4: bhari sitare ki kamiyat 4 x 10^30 kg, radius 5 x 10^8 m aur andaruni dabao 1 x 10^14 Pa hai. Pg = (6.67 x 10^-11)(4 x 10^30)^2 / (5 x 10^8)^4 = 1.07 x 10^51 / 6.25 x 10^34, taqreeban 1.7 x 10^16 Pa. Kashish-e-saql zyada taqatwar hai, is liye sitara sukrega aur aakhir gir sakta hai, shayad neutron star ya black hole ban jaye. Misal 13.5: sitare ki kamiyat 1 x 10^30 kg, radius 1 x 10^9 m aur andaruni dabao 5 x 10^14 Pa hai. Pg = (6.67 x 10^-11)(1 x 10^30)^2 / (1 x 10^9)^4 = 6.67 x 10^49 / 10^36, taqreeban 6.67 x 10^13 Pa. Andaruni dabao zyada hai, is liye sitara phailega aur red giant ban sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Misal 13.3 (kamiyat 2 x 10^30 kg, radius 7 x 10^8 m, andaruni dabao 1.0 x 10^14 Pa) mein kitab Pg = 2.668 x 10^50 / 2.401 x 10^35 ko taqreeban 1.3 x 10^14 Pa chhapti aur kehti hai ke dono dabao barabar hain, is liye sitara mustahkam tawazun mein hai. Taqseem durust karein to taqreeban 1.1 x 10^15 Pa milta hai, andaruni dabao ka taqreeban gyarah guna; is liye kashish-e-saql jeetti hai aur sitara sukrega. Oopar yahi durust hal diya gaya hai. Misal 13.4 mein kitab 1.7 x 10^15 Pa chhapti hai; wahi adad 1.7 x 10^16 Pa dete hain (nateeja wahi rehta hai). Pg = GM^2/R^4 sirf darje ka andaza hai.

blocks.prompt: Pg taqreeban GM^2/R^4 istemal karte hue samjhayein ke jis sitare ka andaruni dabao Pg se kam ho woh kyun sukarta hai.
blocks.explanation: Kashish-e-saql taqreeban Pg ke dabao se andar kheenchti hai; agar bahar ki taraf gas ka dabao kam ho to kul quwwat andar ki taraf hai, is liye sitara sukarta hai. Sukarte hue gas dabti aur garam hoti, dabao barhta, yahan tak ke tawazun bahal ho ya markaz gir jaye.

items: Sitare nebulae se bante; mustahkam sitara kashish aur dabao barabar rakhta (dP/dr = -G Mr rho_r / r^2).
H se He ka fusion sitaron ko chalata; red giant, phir white dwarf (kam kamiyat) ya supernova, neutron star ya black hole (zyada kamiyat).
Bhari sitare sab se kam, red dwarfs sab se zyada jeete.
Sooraj: 4.6 arab saal purana, main sequence par.
